{{Quote|I have my smiler. Once I force the secret of ''savorium'' from his giddy little mind, I'll rule the happiest kingdom in the system!|[[Craw]], to [[Steggus]]|<ref name="Season of Revolt 2" />}}
The '''Targonn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Targonn/Legends|Targonn]],<ref name="Season of Revolt 2" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Targonnian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Targonn system was established in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="TEA release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> which placed the system in grid square U-7.<ref name="TEA" />
